_regle: Coverage floors (task 17.2, decision F10), reviewed file, never lowered, only raised. Replaces: nothing (decision F10). Duration: permanent, a safety net on the masking and verdict code. A floor is the coverage measured at the first run, rounded down. While "provisoire" is true the floors below are 0 and not applied: the session measures, writes the rounded-down values and sets "provisoire" to false; every provisional package carries "mesure_prevue" and "retrait" (a test fails otherwise); never a provisional floor without a deadline (R-20261102-74). test:coverage also runs the tests without database at concurrency 1, slower than test.

server.mesure_prevue: npm run test:coverage dans la phase base du passage en conteneur (base jetable du passage, aucune base sur le Mac) ; la première mesure fixe le plancher (valeur mesurée arrondie vers le bas) et retire provisoire (R-20261102-74)
server.retrait: cette mesure, au plus tard à la revue de tranche du 2026-11-19 (22.1) ; sinon la revue fixe une nouvelle échéance : jamais de provisoire sans échéance (R-20261102-74)
